newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Maseca seen as market performer.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Maseca seen as market performer.

text.p: -- Caspian started coverage of Mexican dominant corn flour producer Grupo Industrial Maseca with a market performer recommendation, setting a 12-month dollar return of 18.9 percent, including a dividend yield of 2.2 percent, and a 12-month peso return of 39.6 percent.

"Following the stock's 93.6 percent U.S. dollar appreciation this year, we believe that Maseca's 1997 (price/earnings ratio) of 10.1x already reflects opportunitites for growth in the corn flour sector, although we view the company as an excellent long-term investment and a strong defensive play," Caspian said.
